data.name: JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa
data.address: Puerto, Fraccion Hotelera Fh5-C1 Subdelegacion De La Playita, 23403 San José del Cabo, B.C.S., Mexico
data.description:
Surrounded by palm trees, this upscale beachfront resort on the Gulf of California is 1 km from the Marina Golf Course and 6 km from Plaza Mijares.
Featuring balconies with gulf views, chic rooms come with Wi-Fi access (fee), flat-screens, iPod docks and sitting areas. Suites offer living rooms with sofabeds; some have whirlpool tubs. Club quarters add perks such as snacks, a breakfast buffet, and access to a pool and a movie theater. Room service is available 24/7.
The 5 bars and restaurants include a deli, a poolside bar, and a cafe offering French fare. There's also an 18-hole golf course, a spa and a gym, plus multiple outdoor pools.
